title: 2011 얼짱 셀카
text:
스타일: 2010년대 초반 한국 싸이월드 얼짱 셀카,
촬영: 디지털카메라 직광 플래시 강하게 사용 플래시가 얼굴 정면에서 터지며 이마, 코, 볼 중심으로 하이라이트가 과하게 날아간 느낌 피부 디테일 블러처리, 전체적으로 뿌옇고 살짝 흐릿한 저해상도 이미지 JPEG 압축된 듯한 질감 화이트밸런스, 약간 노란 톤 핑크빛이 살짝 섞인 과노출 피부톤, 명암 대비 낮고 그림자가 거의 없는 평면적인 느낌,
헤어: 자연스러운 블랙헤어 (염색 금지),뱅 앞머리 + 긴 매직 스트레이트 또는 초코송이 단발헤어 , 과한 웨이브 금지, 학생 느낌 유지, 메이크업: 한국 갸루스타일, 두꺼운 아이라인 눈을 강조하되 눈 크기는 변경하지 않음, 펄감 아주 미세하게 입술은 형광 느낌의 핑크 글로시, 
구도: 얼굴이 화면의 70% 이상 차지 45도 얼짱 각도 카메라를 살짝 위에서 내려찍은 구도, 어설픈 셀카 느낌 (완벽한 구도 금지), 
의상: 2010년대 한국 여고생 교복 평범하고 약간 촌스러운 느낌, 
배경: 한국 고등학교 교실 맨 뒷자리 형광등 + 플래시가 섞인 어색한 조명 거울이나 친구가 흐릿하게 보이면 자연스러움,
장식: 하트 또는 모자이크,삼각형 스티커 저해상 PNG 느낌 과하지 않게 배치 추가, 디테일: 2011년에 실제로 찍힌 싸이월드 셀카 감성, 첨부한 사진 속 인물과 동일 인물로 인식될 수 있도록 눈, 코, 입, 얼굴형의 전체적인 구조와 비율을 유지할 것. 특정 부위를 과장하거나 인위적으로 수정하지 말 것. 원본 얼굴을 기반으로, 해당 스타일 환경에서 새롭게 촬영된 사진처럼 자연스럽게 재구성할 것. 얼굴이 따로 합성된 느낌이 아니라 전체 조명과 색감 안에서 하나의 사진처럼 어우러지게 표현할 것,

title: 즉석 사진
text:
Re-render the provided image as a photograph of a REAL, PHYSICAL Polaroid 600 instant print being held up at arm's length toward the camera. It must look like an actual object photographed, not a digital frame graphic pasted over an image.

RULE 0 — THIS STYLE REQUIRES A DIFFERENT FRAMING FROM THE ORIGINAL. Do not keep the original crop. The ENTIRE provided image is reduced and placed INSIDE the square image area of an instant print, and the picture you output is a new wider shot of that print being held in a hand. Zooming out to show the print and the hand is required, not optional.

RULE 1 — THE PRINT MUST BE VISIBLY TILTED. Rotate the print 2 to 5 degrees in the picture plane. Its edges MUST NOT be parallel to the edges of the photograph — the top edge of the print must clearly slope. It is being held loosely in one hand, so it hangs at a natural casual angle, never squared up to the camera. Do NOT render it perfectly upright, perfectly level, or aligned with the frame. Add a slight depth tilt too so one corner sits a touch closer to the lens.

RULE 2 — THE SUBJECT EXISTS ONLY INSIDE THE PRINT. Whatever is shown in the print must NOT appear anywhere else in the picture. If it is a person, they are the one holding the print — they are taking this photo themselves, so their body is BEHIND the camera and cannot be seen. The background must contain NO person and no second copy of the subject at all: no torso, no shoulders, no arm, no legs, no face, no silhouette, no reflection in any window or glass, and no bystanders or other animals. The ONLY human part visible anywhere is the hand gripping the print. The background must be completely EMPTY of living things.

THE PHYSICAL PRINT:
- PROPORTIONS: the image area is a SQUARE sitting high on the card. The borders on the TOP, LEFT and RIGHT are THIN — about 4mm. The BOTTOM border is the thick tab, roughly SIX TIMES the thickness of the top border. Never make all four borders equal.
- The frame is NOT pure white (#FFFFFF) — a soft warm off-white (#F7F4EF) ivory (#F6F1E7), slightly creamy, with the faint matte texture of real film stock. Pure paper-white reads as fake.
- SURFACE: genuine semi-gloss. A soft real specular reflection of the surrounding light slides diagonally across the image area, so it reads as a glossy physical object catching the room.
- The image area meets the border with very slightly rounded corners and a nearly invisible dark hairline. The card has real thickness — the layered edge is just visible along the nearest side. A faint horizontal seam crosses the thick bottom tab.
- CLEAN and NEW — no creases, folds, tears, fingerprints, ageing or stains.

THE IMAGE INSIDE — real instant film, not a filter:
- Blacks never reach black (#101010); the darkest tone is a soft charcoal-grey with a slight cyan-green cast.
- Highlights roll off and clip early into a warm creamy white, losing detail at the brightest points.
- Low contrast, gentle warm-yellow midtones, faint magenta (#E0218A) in the light areas.
- The centre is reasonably sharp but the CORNERS go noticeably soft and slightly smeared with mild darkening — real instant-camera lens falloff.
- Fine dye-cloud grain across the emulsion, subtle uneven development mottling near the image edges.
Preserve the subject's identity, pose and composition from the provided image exactly — if it is a person keep the exact same face, hair and clothing; if it is an animal keep the exact coat markings; if it is an object or scene keep it recognisable — cropped naturally to the square.

HOW IT IS HELD: filling about 80 percent of the frame width. The hand grips the thick bottom tab between thumb and fingers; only the fingertips and part of the hand enter the bottom of the frame. Correct hand anatomy, exactly five fingers, natural nails, no extra or fused fingers.

BEHIND: a narrow strip of the heavily out-of-focus surroundings from the original photo, emptied of any people or animals. Shallow depth of field so only the print is crisp. Phone camera held close, natural handheld feel, slight vignette.

No text, no handwriting on the border, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no added frame or overlay.
